name: DatePicker
description: A text field with a calendar popover for a single date or a range, and with time it's DateTime: date and time in one field. Typing a date always works; the calendar is an aid. Replaces Livewire's datepicker and datetime.

livewire.name: date-picker
capabilities: wire:model binds value (an ISO string, or an array of two in range mode) through $wire.entangle()
datepicker and datetime stay as deprecated aliases (datetime renders time mode)

props.name: value
props.description: The value as ISO 8601: a date (2026-11-12), a date and time in time mode (2026-11-12T11:00), or an array of two dates in range mode. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled date picker.

props.name: mode
props.description: One date, or a range of two (two inputs in one box). Emitted as data-mode.

props.name: time
props.description: Date and time (DateTime): adds a time list beside the month, and the value carries the time. Single mode only. Emitted as data-time.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the times in the time list.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The IANA time zone the time is in, shown under the field in time mode and used for today's date. Default: none shown, UTC for today.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names, the first day of the week and the default text pattern. Livewire defaults to the app locale, React and Vue to en-US.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest date that can be chosen, ISO.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest date that can be chosen, ISO.

props.name: disabledDates
props.description: Dates that can't be chosen, as ISO strings. They're struck through.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6. Follows the locale unless set.

props.name: format
props.description: The text pattern, with yyyy, MM and dd tokens (dd.MM.yyyy). Follows the locale unless set; typing always works in it.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the (first) input.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the field, linked with aria-describedby. Show the expected format here.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and the calendar.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Makes the field read-only: it stays focusable, the calendar doesn't open.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text. Defaults to the pattern, MM/DD/YYYY.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the ISO value under this name in a hidden input (two, name[], in range mode).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the calendar is open. Vue binds it with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled popover.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the popover at the end of the body (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: footer
props.description: A row under the calendar, such as a summary and an Apply button.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The calendar button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Choose date' ) (or 'Choose date and time').
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: The previous-month button's accessible name. Livewire defaults it through __( 'Previous month' ).

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: The next-month button's accessible name. Livewire defaults it through __( 'Next month' ).

props.name: calendarLabel
props.description: The popover's accessible name. Livewire defaults it through __( 'Calendar' ).

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: The time list's name and heading. Livewire defaults it through __( 'Time' ).

props.name: endLabel
props.description: The end input's accessible name in range mode. Livewire defaults it through __( 'End date' ).

props.name: timeZoneLabel
props.description: The time-zone line, with {zone} for the zone. Livewire defaults it through __( 'Time zone: :zone' ).

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { control: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, control, hint, time zone and error. Zag's root part.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the first input.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the input is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the trigger and the input(s): Zag's control part, renamed to the field anatomy's box (D-018).

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The calendar icon at the start of the box: an icon-only button that opens the popover.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native text input, typed in the pattern: Zag's input part, renamed to the field anatomy's control (D-018). Range mode has two. Attributes other than class land on the first.

parts.name: hint
parts.description: Help text.

parts.name: timeZone
parts.description: The time zone, in time mode.

parts.name: error
parts.description: Validation message, with an icon.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Places the popover under the field.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The popover panel: the month, the time column and the footer.

parts.name: view
parts.description: The month: its header and grid.

parts.name: viewControl
parts.description: The header: previous month, the month's name, next month.

parts.name: prevTrigger
parts.description: Previous month: a ghost, neutral, small icon-only Button. Its arrow mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: rangeText
parts.description: The visible month and year, from Intl in the locale.

parts.name: nextTrigger
parts.description: Next month. Its arrow mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: table
parts.description: The month grid (role=grid).

parts.name: tableHead
parts.description: The weekday row. Hidden from screen readers; each day's name says its weekday.

parts.name: tableRow
parts.description: A week, or the weekday row.

parts.name: tableHeader
parts.description: A weekday name, from Intl in the locale.

parts.name: tableBody
parts.description: The weeks.

parts.name: tableCell
parts.description: A day's cell (role=gridcell, aria-selected).

parts.name: tableCellTrigger
parts.description: A day: today, selected, in range, outside the month or unavailable through data attributes.

parts.name: time
parts.description: The time column, in time mode.

parts.name: timeLabel
parts.description: The time column's heading. Hidden from screen readers; the list carries the same name.

parts.name: timeList
parts.description: The times (role=listbox).

parts.name: timeOption
parts.description: One time (role=option, aria-selected).

parts.name: footer
parts.description: The row under the calendar.

events.name: value-change
events.description: A day, a time or typed text changed the value. Reports the ISO value.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popover opened or closed itself: the trigger, Escape, outside click or a choice. Setting open doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Moves between the trigger and the input; typing a date in the pattern always works.
On the trigger, opens the calendar; on a day, chooses it.
Previous and next day. They follow the text direction, so they swap under RTL.
Same day of the previous and next week; in the time list, the previous and next time.
Previous and next month (Shift for a year).
Start and end of the week; in the time list, the first and last time.
Closes the calendar and returns focus to the field.

requirements: Typing a date always works; the calendar never replaces the input.
The month is role=grid; each day names its full localized date, and its cell carries aria-selected, aria-disabled and aria-current=date for today.
Arrow keys follow the text direction, and the previous and next arrows mirror in RTL.
Month and weekday names come from Intl in the locale; every built-in label is a translatable prop.
The calendar button is labelled and reports aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The time list is a listbox of options with roving focus; the time zone is always visible when set.
Unavailable days are struck through as well as muted, never color alone; the selected day is filled, today has a ring.
Hint and error are linked to the input with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid.
Every server-rendered part keeps a stable id in Livewire; the calendar is client-rendered inside wire:ignore (D-015).
